name: Supah Edge v0 — workload-derived architecture hypothesis
status: Reference-host capacity scenario and architecture requirements; not RTL or a fabricated chip
measured_scope: Native Muni code on a bounded public-source replay; single process, warm OS caches

service_requests.pipeline_basis: Sum of isolated stage medians, not an end-to-end measured speedup
service_requests.amdahl_assumption: Only this stage becomes infinitely fast; all other stage times and workload stay fixed

building_permits.pipeline_basis: Sum of isolated stage medians, not an end-to-end measured speedup
building_permits.amdahl_assumption: Only this stage becomes infinitely fast; all other stage times and workload stay fixed

limitations: Service-demand estimate only; excludes queues, synchronization, cold caches and contention
Same host, same Ruby runtime and same dataset sizes; not a prediction for an ARM or RISC-V custom core
Excludes generative inference, full analytics refresh, network fetch, other server work and production redundancy
SQLite writer serialization and Ruby process/thread behavior require a separate concurrency benchmark

cpu_tile.decision: Start with programmable 64-bit CPU cores and shared cache for Ruby, SQLite, ranking and empirical prediction
cpu_tile.evidence: These measured operations execute through the CPU software path; CPU time alone cannot distinguish ALU from memory stalls

memory.decision: Begin evaluation on a shared-memory SoC; measure working set and cache misses before fixing SRAM or external-memory bandwidth
memory.hbm: Not justified by this small replay; local LLM weights and KV-cache requirements remain unmeasured

io.decision: Keep durable records in external storage; retain standard storage/network DMA and normal OS support

inference_tile.decision: Reserve an optional programmable inference-accelerator interface; select NPU/GPU only after profiling a chosen local model

custom_kernel_gate.decision: Prototype candidate kernels in software/FPGA before creating dedicated RTL
first_candidates: Batched columnar filtering or context assembly

packaging.decision: Evaluate a CPU/memory/I-O SoC with an optional accelerator; 2.5D is a later bandwidth/capacity decision

simulation_bridge.track_1: Use the explicit rates and reference-host service demand as a workload-sizing input; add measured system power and concurrency
simulation_bridge.track_2: Retain the verified four-GPU/four-HBM challenge layout unchanged. These CPU timings cannot be converted into its synthetic power maps
simulation_bridge.next_thermal_input: Calibrated per-component power traces plus a physically defined custom architecture outside the frozen challenge

unmeasured.llm_execution: Skipped by user; request preparation is not model inference
